(** angelo5fix (repaired AngeloJacobo/RISC-V 5-stage RV32I) D step and final theorem: the generic pipeline obligation skeleton
    (CPUPipelineObligations) with [Runtime = State], no post-fetch stages in the skeleton (the 4 pipeline tokens live in the INV),
    the joint INV [Inv] = real reset | operating [A5TmplInv.Op] (10 reachable control vectors; tokens at ISA positions
    memory 0, execute v4, decode v4+v3), the commit condition = the target observer's own bit (writeback_ce on the driven state),
    token = memoryaccess_pc, rank = [A5TmplInv.rank] (cycles to the next commit; jump refill: 4 silent cycles, ranks 4..1).
    Final: from the real reset, the RTL ITree refines the ISA ITree for every program of the 29-class jump-family domain
    [CPUJumpFamilyProgramDomain.check_program].
    proof_author: LLM-generated: Claude Code (claude-opus-5-5); external_llm_api_calls=0. *)

valid.meaning: the target observer's own commit bit: writeback_ce on the driven state

pending_view.note: RF lanes = ISA registers of the committed state; pending writes of the execute / memory tokens enter the operands through the forwarding unit (A5TmplFwdLift.fwd_op)

front.cursor: front pc fr = fetch o_pc (v1) | prev_pc (ce) | o_iaddr; fr = decode pc + 4 (decode token) or the ISA pc after the in-flight tokens

operating.step_shape: commit: exists y index', run1 f = (Some tt, y) /\ token = pc f /\ Op (cycle s) y index'; silent: Op (cycle s) f index /\ rank decreases
